page.overview:
Who is Cadro Borrigan?

Cadro Borrigan was a male businessman who owned a Restaurant in the Cultural District on Ord Radama. Cadro's restaurant was very upscale, and served some of the finest dishes on Ord Radama. There were also a collection of games such as Pazaak for the customers to play.
